section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study that investigated the reliability and validity of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in a sample of 228 Black college women. The study also explored the relationship between ethnic identity and body appreciation, finding a moderate positive association. Overall, the findings support the use of the BAS with Black college women.
